2608.25199.title: Hyperbolic Latent Geometry for Tree-Structured Prototype Networks: A Local-vs-Global Trade-off
2608.25199.paper_summary: We study a tree-structured regularizer over class-prototype layouts in a hierarchical-classification model and ask whether the choice of latent manifold for the prototypes (Euclidean R^d vs. the Poincare ball B^d_c) affects how well that regularizer can be satisfied without distorting the data likelihood. The two manifolds differ only in their volume growth: hyperbolic space grows exponentially with radius and embeds trees with provably lower distortion than R^d of matched dimension, so the structured regularizer should be cheaper to satisfy on B^d_c. Across 150 seed-replicated regularized maximum-likelihood fits spanning embedding dimension, curvature, and regularizer strength on WikiArt (27 styles, 81,446 paintings, frozen CLIP ViT-B/16 features), we find a single robust effect: Poincare prototypes preserve the topology of the nearest-neighbor graph in latent space substantially better than matched Euclidean prototypes (sibling recall@5 +8.7 pp, cousin recall +15.2 pp; paired-t p < 10^-4, sign agreement 0.94), and the gap holds across three reference-tree definitions (hand-built lineage, CLIP-derived, and DINOv2-derived). On classification, Euclidean prototypes are tied with logistic regression on raw encoder features, indicating no detectable contribution from the latent geometry; only the hyperbolic fit improves on a k-NN encoder baseline for local retrieval. Global tree-fidelity comparisons are unstable across reference trees and we do not claim a winner. The results give an empirical separation, on a real hierarchical-classification problem, between two natural latent geometries for a class-structured regularizer.
2608.25199.paper_summary_zh: 我們研究了一種樹狀結構的正則化器，應用於階層分類模型中的類別原型佈局，並探討原型的潛在流形選擇（歐幾里得 R^d 與 Poincare 球 B^d_c）是否影響該正則化器在不扭曲數據似然的情況下的滿足程度。這兩種流形僅在其體積增長上有所不同：超曲面空間隨半徑指數增長，並且在可證明的情況下，以比匹配維度的 R^d 更低的扭曲嵌入樹，因此在 B^d_c 上滿足結構化正則化器的成本應該更低。在 150 次種子複製的正則化最大似然擬合中，涵蓋了嵌入維度、曲率和正則化器強度，針對 WikiArt（27 種風格，81,446 幅畫作，凍結的 CLIP ViT-B/16 特徵），我們發現了一個單一的穩健效應：Poincare 原型在潛在空間中比匹配的歐幾里得原型更好地保留了最近鄰圖的拓撲結構（兄弟召回率@5 增加了 8.7 個百分點，表親召回率增加了 15.2 個百分點；配對 t 檢驗 p < 10^-4，符號一致性 0.94），而且這一差距在三種參考樹定義（手工構建的譜系、CLIP 衍生的和 DINOv2 衍生的）中均保持不變。在分類方面，歐幾里得原型與原始編碼器特徵上的邏輯回歸持平，這表明潛在幾何沒有可檢測的貢獻；只有超曲面擬合在 k-NN 編碼器基準上改善了本地檢索。全球樹忠實度比較在參考樹之間不穩定，我們不聲稱有勝者。這些結果在一個真實的階層分類問題上，為類別結構正則化器的兩種自然潛在幾何提供了實證分離。
2608.25199.author: Peter Flo et.al.
